thread: Julie Park: quick heads-up — Nimbus Health POC kickoff tomorrow. They want a 2-week sandbox. Need to lock sample data access, redaction approach, and confirm any pricing for dedicated test capacity. can we align?
Julie Park: cc @Ben Carter for solution design, @Priya Rao for security asks, and @Dan Kim for infra/connectivity
Ben Carter: short checklist: 1) what sample data size + format 2) redaction rules 3) access method (presigned S3 / VPC) 4) success criteria (latency/throughput/qual)

Mateo Alvarez (Nimbus): FYI — customer will share a de-identified subset of EHR JSONs (~3k records, ~2.5GB) and want redaction validated. Goal: intent extraction & summarization prompts. POC success = >=95% on extraction eval and <300ms p95 for single-turn summaries.

Priya Rao: we need the security questionnaire filled before we get any live data. also please confirm they will sign our DPA and accept our data retention policy (14 days max). request SOC2 report from Nimbus if not provided.

Ben Carter: for POC I'd prefer synthetic + a redacted sample from Nimbus. we can run redaction checks locally with our script. quick redaction example we can share:

```bash
python tools/redact.py --input sample.json --rules rules.yml --output sample_redacted.json
```

rules.yml should include PHI patterns and free-text heuristics.

Dan Kim: infra notes — two options: 1) short-lived STS creds -> presigned S3 URLs for us to pull sample files (easiest), or 2) VPC peering / S3 gateway if they want private network. For 2) we need 3-5 days to schedule and security signoffs. Which do they prefer?
Mateo Alvarez (Nimbus): presigned URLs preferred (no infra changes), also ok with temporary IAM role. They want no persistent keys stored in our system. Will also sign the DPA.

Priya Rao: presigned okay. we still require the redaction rules before we ingest. send the rules and we will run automated checks (named policy: poc-data-ingest-review). Also we need a one-page risk acceptance for de-identified EHRs.

Ben Carter: suggested redaction minimums: remove MRN, SSN, DOB (keep age buckets), provider names hashed, and free-text scrub PHI entities. We'll provide pattern list and a quick unit test harness for them.

Julie Park: timeline proposal:
- Day 0 (tomorrow): kickoff & we send redaction script + security questionnaire
- Day 2: Nimbus shares presigned URLs to a single test bucket (2.5GB sample)
- Day 3-4: redaction validation + synthetic augmentations
- Week 1: run prompt eval set (200 prompts) -> baseline metrics
- Week 2: iterate prompts & infra tuning, deliver final report
Can we commit to that?

Dan Kim: infra readiness: if presigned route, we'll need one engineer (0.5d) to ingest & validate, then enable S3 caching and prefix/KV caching. For p95 <300ms we should use 8-core GPU pool in Dedicated trial — pricing note below.

Ben Carter: success criteria (POC):
- Extraction precision >=95% on provided eval set
- Summarization p95 <300ms for 512-token output
- End-to-end throughput >=10 req/s with batching policy
- No data retention beyond 14 days and redaction pass
If any fail, we log regressions and propose model/quant changes.
Julie Park: pricing question from Nimbus — will we bill for Dedicated trial? they asked if trial capacity is complimentary or discounted. Mateo?

Mateo Alvarez (Nimbus): request: discounted trial credits would be helpful. we have internal approval for a small budget but prefer a reduced-rate POC. also need an estimate of expected token cost for 2 weeks (200 prompts * 4k tokens average + 10k summaries).

Ben Carter: rough cost calc: prompts eval ~200 * 4k tokens = 800k tokens. summaries 10k * 1k tokens = 10M tokens. total ~10.8M tokens. with trial discount we can cap at $X (we'll give a quote). For Dedicated GPU we can offer 50% off trial rate for first month — need approval from sales lead.
Priya Rao: also flag enterprise blocker: third-party code in their EHR export — legal may require review. please escalate if they want on-prem deployment or private plane.

Julie Park: next actions:
- Ben: send redact script + eval harness tomorrow morning
- Priya: email security questionnaire template and our DPA link
- Dan: prep quick runbook for presigned ingestion (include STS policy example)
- Mateo: share presigned URLs once redaction rules accepted
I'll follow up after kickoff. :thumbsup:
Dan Kim: noted — I'll include caching params to hit p95 target and a note on enabling prefix cache for repeated prompts. I'll also attach the infra playbook after kickoff.
Mateo Alvarez (Nimbus): thanks everyone. I'll try to get the security pack and presigned URLs by EOD today. Expect a small follow-up from our legal on DPA wording.
security-bot: reminder — attach SOC2 report via secure link. For any PHI-like data, enable monitoring and generate audit log export weekly.
Julie Park: perfect. closing loop here — will reconvene post-kickoff and update thread. thanks!
